builds.howItPlays: You play cheap units like Pit Rookie and put gear on them, and Lucian's ability gives every equipped unit +1 Might while it attacks, so a 2-cost Doran's Blade (+2 Might) turns a small unit into a real attacker. You attack both battlefields early and save Blighted Battleaxe (+4 Might) for a unit that will win its fight that turn, because the axe falls off any unit that fails to conquer.
builds.whyYou: You like starting fights early and making every small unit count. You enjoy the choices this deck asks for each turn: which unit gets the sword, when to commit the Battleaxe, which battlefield to hit first. You don't mind the odd slow start when your units and gear don't arrive together, because a good opening lets you score most of your points before your opponent gets going. If turning cheap units into big attackers sounds fun, this Lucian suits you.
builds.ratingNotes: Changed 2026-09-25 (re-rate from the deck picks, style "Equipment Aggro Lucian"). The label moves from Tempo to Aggro. Coordinates move from 6.5/7.5/6.5/4.5 to 6/7.5/5/4.5 (pace/stance/complexity/variance), the mean of three scored decks. Complexity drops by 1.5, which reaches the move threshold, and pace drops by 0.5. The old numbers and label came from the riftbound.gg and hextechanalytics guides, not scored lists. Those guides were split: riftbound.gg leaned Midrange and hextechanalytics leaned Aggro. All three raters said Aggro, and tools.ts style gives Aggro. I dropped those two guideUrls because I did not re-read them in this pass to confirm they describe this list. deckListUrl was the bare /decks page and now points to the Barcelona list. The style name comes from the picks. Scored decks: BEST OF LUCIAN - RCQ BARCELONA (BANRATE_DEMON; 4 likes, guide; the system account posted the same list as the Barcelona RQ Best of) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/940d1f80-2f39-473e-8fee-0127760b9830 Aggro 6.5/7.5/5/4. Singapore RQ Best of Lucian (Motionless) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/49460e53-60d2-48d2-9cb7-7e826eee3d85 Aggro 6/7.5/5/4.5. Lucian - Set 4 Update (Guerte; 1 like) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/966dfb6d-7657-475b-8e6c-1ed5457c43ea Aggro 6/7.5/5/4.5. Mean 6/7.5/5/4.5. On the Singapore and Guerte lists the scorer suggested Midrange because final Pace is 6, just under the Aggro line. The rater judged Aggro, and the label follows the raters. Adjustments (same on all three sheets): stance +0.5, because the Legend gives every equipped unit Assault, so the gear is attack power. Complexity +0.5, because Forge of the Fluft lets the Legend move Equipment between units each turn. Deciding cards: Pace comes from 23 units, 6 of them costing 2 or less (Pit Rookie, Irresistible Faefolk), with Legion-discounted Noxus Hopeful and Accelerate Kai'Sa, Survivor. Only 3 to 4 cards cost 5+ (Ferrous Forerunner, Poppy). Stance comes from about 24 to 26 pressure cards against 4 to 5 answers (Falling Star, Sabotage, Rampage). Complexity comes from sequencing the equips of Doran's Blade, Long Sword and Blighted Battleaxe, plus Relentless Pursuit and Punch First timing. Variance: 68 to 82% of cards are 3-ofs, and Blighted Battleaxe is flagged swing; the deck wants early units and gear together. Legend ability: your Equipment each give Assault (+1 Might while the equipped unit is an attacker). Also played: Skyfall Trinity Lucian, the Skyfall of Areion + Trinity Force engine that scores the hold point on each conquer, doubled at Red Brambleback's battlefield: https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/5339f255-8993-41b7-9d26-cc5c18c1a04f (MikX, Red Buff Combo; Combo 6/7.5/6.5/5.5), https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/7c8a3118-142b-407f-bb38-c23f8867586a (Draconuxx; Combo 5/6/6.5/5.5), https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/b4cf9557-3624-48b7-a03b-c880cbe4f752 (Utrecht RQ Best of, Chimärin; pre-Vendetta; Combo 4/6/6.5/5). Rengar and Akshan Lucian, which trades the Pit Rookie, Noxus Hopeful and Forerunner package for Akshan, Rengar and Angle Shot: https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/b0fc45b2-06eb-4732-93b8-abb6da11ed06 (Tavian, edited 2026-09-23; Aggro 6/7.5/6/4). Confidence: low. The bar is loosened because no deck in the style is strong, though both current RQ Best-ofs sit here and all three raters agree. Reviewer: the lead agent, not the Maintainer, chose Equipment Aggro over Skyfall Trinity as the single Build. Check that call. Also check whether Skyfall Trinity (Combo) should become a second Build: its Archetype differs, but it sits within 1.5 on every Axis (about 5/6.5/6.5/5.3), so the Distinct rule folds it in. The copy's claim that Blighted Battleaxe comes off a unit that fails to conquer follows the card text ('If I didn't conquer this turn, unattach this and deal 4 to me'). The copy leaves out the 4 damage because the card text is ambiguous about what takes it.
